tasks.subject: Task 1: internal/presence gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The Gate: SSE-fed activity tracking with linger, boot grace, per-transition wake signals, disabled mode permanently active.

**Files:**
- Create: internal/presence/presence.go
- Create: internal/presence/presence_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] boot grace then idle after linger
- [ ] Connect on idle -> active + one signal per subscriber per transition; connects while active signal nothing
- [ ] active for linger after last Disconnect, then idle
- [ ] disabled: always active, never signals

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/presence/ -count=1 -v -> all PASS

**Steps:** TDD, full code in plan Task 1. git commit -s, never Co-Authored-By.

tasks.subject: Task 3: gate poller + working-set dispatch
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Poller skips ticks while idle and wakes on transition; working set drops dispatches in sendJob while idle (Add/Signal/scheduler paths) and drains on wake.

**Files:**
- Modify: internal/obs/poller.go + poller_test.go
- Modify: internal/workingset/workingset.go + workingset_test.go
- Modify: cmd/obsboard/main.go (NewPoller gains nil gate arg)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] idle poller: startup tick only; wake -> immediate tick; nil gate unchanged
- [ ] idle working set: Add suppressed via sendJob guard; wake drains; nil gate unchanged
- [ ] obs+workingset tests and go build pass

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestPollerRunGated -count=1 -v && go test ./internal/workingset/ -run TestGate -count=1 -v -> PASS

**Steps:** TDD, full code in plan Task 3. git commit -s, never Co-Authored-By.
